_README: Packages whose MAJOR version change a pin preview reports but does not gate (tappaas-train preview, #788). Each entry says why its major is not a break for TAPPaaS. Date and sequence versions (first number 100 or more) are never gated and need no entry here.

packages.xgcc: GCC's runtime libraries (libgcc_s, libstdc++), present in every closure: they move with every GCC release and keep their ABI
packages.gfortran: the Fortran runtime that numeric libraries link; moves with GCC like xgcc
packages.linux-headers-static: kernel headers used to build, not a running kernel; the kernel itself (linux) is still compared
